page_segmentation.description: Shipment Cartage Advice, Cargo documents, and Air Waybills

data.rationale: The document is identified as an invoice because it contains vendor information (Blueharbor Logistics & Services), line items with quantities, unit prices, and total amounts, as well as payment terms and due dates. Pages 1 and 2 clearly form a single invoice. Pages 3-11 appear to be supporting shipping and cargo documents related to the shipment, and page 12 is a separate invoice from Polvex Distribution. Since the primary document (pages 1-2) is an invoice and the other documents are supporting or a secondary invoice, the overall document is classified as an INVOICE and marked for processing. The system will need to handle the secondary invoice separately.
